text: 每次野外考察都是难得的机会，必须努力争取。密斯卡托尼克大学是所优秀的学府，但改变已知世界的发现发生在此地——在文明边缘，在艰苦而危险的探索中。你现在还不能放弃。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 425
text: Every field trip is a rare opportunity that must be fought for. Miskatonic is a wonderful institution, but the discoveries that change the known world are made here, on its fringes, through painstaking and dangerous exploration. You cannot give up yet.
